questions.question:
Choose the correct sentence.

I ______ to the cinema last night.

We ______ a film.

He ______ his car recently.

They ______ dinner when the phone rang.
options: have watched, has eaten, has repaired, were having
had watched, had eaten, had repaired, were having
watched, had eaten, had repaired, had having

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses the present perfect tense?
options: I have never seen such a beautiful sunset.
I have seen such a beautiful sunset.
I never have seen such a beautiful sunset.
I never seen such a beautiful sunset.
questions.answer: I have never seen such a beautiful sunset.

questions.question:
Complete the sentence with the correct comparative form.

The weather in summer is ______ than in winter in this country.
Which conditional sentence correctly describes a hypothetical situation in the future?
options: If it rains tomorrow, we will cancel the picnic.
If it rains tomorrow, we would cancel the picnic.
If it rains tomorrow, we would have cancelled the picnic.
If it rains tomorrow, we would be cancelling the picnic.
questions.answer: If it rains tomorrow, we would cancel the picnic.

questions.question:
Select the correct modal verb.

You must finish your homework ______ you will not be allowed to go out tonight.

Choose the correct infinitive or gerund form to complete the sentence.

After ______ the news, she decided to tell her friend.
Which sentence uses a linker correctly to connect ideas of contrast?
options: The movie was very long, but I enjoyed it.
The movie was very long, however I enjoyed it.
The movie was very long, so I enjoyed it.
The movie was very long, therefore I enjoyed it.
questions.answer: The movie was very long, but I enjoyed it.

questions.question:
Complete the sentence with the correct phrasal verb.

Don't forget to ______ your passport when you go to the airport.
Which word is a synonym for 'opportunity' in this context?

Select the correct preposition to complete the sentence.

She was angry ______ him for being so rude.
